Regarding the operational processes at QuickDeliver, the text identifies two primary bottlenecks: physical congestion in the packaging area due to insufficient space and inefficient prioritization of express shipments by the sorting system. To improve efficiency, QuickDeliver should expand the physical footprint of the packaging area or reorganize the layout to maximize available space. Additionally, the sorting system needs to be updated or reconfigured to automatically prioritize express shipments, ensuring they are processed before standard orders to reduce delays.
